description: This file implements access control logic for property fields and values within the Mattermost server, including mechanisms for protected fields, access modes, and filtering based on caller permissions. It defines a service class with methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and filtering property fields and values, enforcing access restrictions based on source plugins, protection status, and access modes.

classes.name: PropertyAccessService
classes.description: A decorator class that enforces access control on property fields and values, wrapping the core PropertyService and adding permission checks based on caller identity, source plugins, protection status, and access modes.

methods.name: NewPropertyAccessService
methods.description: Constructor for PropertyAccessService, wrapping a PropertyService with optional plugin checker.

methods.name: CreatePropertyField
methods.description: Creates a new property field, enforcing restrictions on source_plugin_id and protected status.

methods.name: CreatePropertyFieldForPlugin
methods.description: Creates a property field on behalf of a plugin, automatically setting source_plugin_id.

methods.name: GetPropertyField
methods.description: Retrieves a property field with access filtering based on caller permissions.

methods.name: UpdatePropertyField
methods.description: Updates a property field after permission checks, ensuring source_plugin_id remains unchanged.

methods.name: DeletePropertyField
methods.description: Deletes a property field after permission checks.

methods.name: CreatePropertyValue
methods.description: Creates a property value after permission checks.

methods.name: UpdatePropertyValue
methods.description: Updates a property value after permission checks.

methods.name: DeletePropertyValue
methods.description: Deletes a property value after permission checks.

methods.name: GetPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a property value with access filtering.

methods.name: SearchPropertyValues
methods.description: Searches for property values with access filtering.

methods.name: UpsertPropertyValue
methods.description: Creates or updates a property value with permission checks.

methods.name: DeletePropertyValuesForTarget
methods.description: Deletes all property values for a target after permission checks.

methods.name: DeletePropertyValuesForField
methods.description: Deletes all property values for a field after permission checks.

methods.name: getSourcePluginID
methods.description: Extracts source_plugin_id attribute from a property field.

methods.name: getAccessMode
methods.description: Extracts access_mode attribute from a property field.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedFieldReadAccess
methods.description: Checks if caller has unrestricted read access to a field (public or source plugin).

methods.name: ensureSourcePluginIDUnchanged
methods.description: Ensures source_plugin_id attribute is immutable during updates.

methods.name: validateProtectedFieldUpdate
methods.description: Validates that setting protected=true is allowed based on source plugin.

methods.name: checkFieldWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if caller can modify a protected or unprotected field.

methods.name: checkFieldDeleteAccess
methods.description: Checks if caller can delete a protected or unprotected field.

methods.name: getCallerValuesForField
methods.description: Retrieves all property values for caller on a specific field, used for shared_only filtering.

methods.name: extractOptionIDsFromValue
methods.description: Parses JSON value to extract option IDs for select/multiselect fields.

methods.name: copyPropertyField
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a PropertyField, including Attrs.

methods.name: getCallerOptionIDsForField
methods.description: Retrieves all option IDs the caller has for a specific field.

methods.name: filterSharedOnlyFieldOptions
methods.description: Filters a field's options to only those the caller has selected.

methods.name: filterSharedOnlyValue
methods.description: Filters a value for shared_only fields to only include options the caller has.

methods.name: applyFieldReadAccessControl
methods.description: Applies read access filtering to a single field based on caller permissions.

methods.name: applyFieldReadAccessControlToList
methods.description: Applies read access filtering to a list of fields.

methods.name: getFieldsForValues
methods.description: Fetches all unique fields associated with a list of property values.

methods.name: applyValueReadAccessControl
methods.description: Filters a list of property values based on caller permissions and access modes.

methods.name: groupHasAccessRestrictions
methods.description: Checks if a group has access restrictions based on its name.
